summary: First-run E2E testing of Timesheet app. Backend 27/27 pytest tests passing covering auth, employee CRUD, lock logic, submit/resubmit/review, reports, CSV, reminders. Frontend admin flow verified end-to-end (login, tabs, employee create, CSV download, send-reminders). Employee dashboard lock-banner + submit flow not fully verified via UI due to httpOnly cookie persistence between logins in playwright session, but backend tests cover all lock/submit/resubmit semantics.
action_items: (Optional) Add aria-describedby or DialogDescription to AddEmployeeDialog and ReviewDialog to silence Radix accessibility warnings.

(Code-quality) server.py line 244: `locked = last_ts is None and today.weekday() >= 0` — second clause is always True; the comment about 'only lock if last week's Friday has passed' is not implemented. Current behavior matches the product spec ('lock until previous week submitted'), so functionally OK, but consider removing the dead-code clause + misleading comment for clarity.
(Security) CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True. Browsers will reject this combo for credentialed requests. Replace '*' with explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfiguration: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is invalid per spec; cookies won't be sent cross-origin. Frontend currently relies on Bearer header from localStorage so it works, but cookie-based auth would silently fail.
seed_admin properly updates password if .env changed (good).
bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ (verified via successful login).
Timesheets correctly cascade-delete on employee delete.
Rejected timesheet resubmission correctly removes old doc before insert (line 311).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (admin flows fully verified, employee submit verified via API)

test_credentials: admin@timesheet.com / admin123 (seeded). Test employees created at runtime are deleted by tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary employees with TEST/UI prefix and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Today in container = 2026-04-26 (Sun). Current week Mon = 2026-04-20, last week Mon = 2026-04-13. New employees start with locked=true. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_timesheet_api.py is reusable. Frontend testids: emp-id-input, emp-name-input, emp-email-input, emp-password-input (NOT create-employee-{id,name,email,password}). EmployeeDashboard uses hours-input (not total-hours-input). Admin tab testids: tab-timesheets, tab-employees, tab-reports. To test employee flow in playwright, must clear cookies (not just localStorage) since access_token is httpOnly: use context.clear_cookies() before re-login.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All backend endpoints meet spec including lock (HTTP 423), Monday-only validation, future-week rejection, rejected resubmission, and admin review state machine.
